lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: The rickety rope bridge sways as a goblin chief steps out of the mist. He snarles, who dares cross Grubnak's bridge.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Stand aside, little one, or taste my axe.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Wait, Thorin. Let me try talking first. Great Grubnak. We come bearing gold.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Okay, out of character. Can someone pass the chips?"

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Grubnak laughs and draws a rusty blade. Roll Initiative.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: I swing my axe at Grubnak. That's an 18 to hit.
